## Data structures affected
Markdown only: the processed-docs heading count, one list bullet, and one appended section with a table. No schemas or JSON.

## API or interface changes
None. `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` reads the processed-docs list from the report (`APPLY_ANALYSIS_REPORT_PATH`). With the new bullet, it will skip the 2026-10-08 doc from now on. That is the intended effect.

## Decisions
### D1 — Where to check whether sibling work landed
- Chosen: check on the planning/integration ref `orchestrator/project-9099`, which is the branch this PR targets.
- Alternatives considered: check against `isolated-base` (the default branch), as the issue literally says.
- Why: siblings merge into the integration branch, which reaches main as one unit. On `isolated-base` all six changes are absent, which would wrongly mark every one as "deferred".

### D2 — Leave the test file unedited
- Chosen: re-run `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py` without changing it.
- Alternatives considered: add a test asserting that the real report lists the deleted doc.
- Why: every test there builds its own temporary report and doc files, so deleting the real doc changes nothing it checks. A new real-repo test would go beyond the issue's scope (minimal change).

### D3 — Processing date and source commit
- Chosen: use the UTC date of the implement run as `Processed:`, and `04ce31c95ce53a9b7918f52bb5fab23136c95745` as the source commit.
- Alternatives considered: leave a placeholder for the merge date.
- Why: the merge date is unknown at implement time. Earlier closeouts (for example 2026-10-07-4) record the implement date. The issue gives the source commit.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint or secret is touched; the change is documentation plus one file deletion.
- The PR body and commit messages must use `Refs #9099` and no closing keyword, because #9099 is the `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue. Run `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` on the body.
- Do not read or modify any other file under `analysis/`, especially `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` and `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`.

## Risks and edge cases
- **Conflict with the issue text:** it says to check the "current default branch", but siblings landed on the integration branch (see D1). Recorded as an assumption.
- **Open PR #9057 also edits the report.** Appending at the end and changing only two existing lines keeps any merge conflict small.
